baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative لِأَيِّ modifies يَوْمٍ, while passive أُجِّلَتْ supplies an unnamed patient and a fixed temporal limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question selects a bounded day from possible endpoints: an unspecified referent has been assigned or deferred to that limit.

activation_trace.role: The bounded ordinary-day image makes the requested endpoint date-like.
The fixed-term image supplies the terminal boundary to which the passive patient is assigned.

changed_reading.after: A scheduling question asks the exact bounded day to which an unnamed referent has been assigned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمٍ can denote a severe occurrence as well as a calendar day, and أُجِّلَتْ fixes its limit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative may seek the kind of culminating occasion rather than a date number; appointment points toward an event-threshold.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day image converts the temporal noun into a consequential occurrence.
The appointed-limit image gives that occurrence a predetermined threshold.

changed_reading.before: The question asks which calendar date was selected.
changed_reading.after: The question asks toward which severe, culminating occasion the unnamed referent was reserved.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Passive أُجِّلَتْ remains the grammatical anchor, with the root's collecting-basin branch offering a material image for temporal retention.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deferral can be pictured as holding contents intact through an open span until a designated outlet rather than as empty inactivity.

activation_trace.role: The open-span image provides the interval across which retention operates.
The water-collecting basin image supplies a branch-distant but concrete model of holding before release.

changed_reading.before: Deferral is only a later date.
changed_reading.after: Deferral is an interval of retained potential whose contents await an appointed outlet.

context_deltas.mechanism: A temporally bounded promise is declared to fall and become established; the focus appointment therefore marks guaranteed materialization, not uncertain postponement.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day image anchors materialization in the focus noun.
The fixed-term image supplies the promised event's endpoint.
The appointment-by-time-or-place image makes the prior promise structurally parallel to the focus scheduling.
The falling-and-becoming-fixed image turns futurity into certain arrival.

structural_cues: 77:7 pairs a passive promise with an emphatic predicate of occurrence before the focus question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded promise and its certain occurrence; I connect the appointed focus-day to that materialization. A live alternative is that 77:7 asserts certainty without specifying the mechanism of 77:12.

changed_reading.before: The unnamed matter may simply have been delayed.
changed_reading.after: Its appointment is the guaranteed landing point at which what was promised becomes an established event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding messengers are themselves time-bounded, resolving the passive patient toward that collective and shifting أُجِّلَتْ from generic delay toward formal scheduling.

activation_trace.role: The open temporal span anchors the day to which the schedule points.
The appointed-limit image anchors the focus as a docketing act.
The messenger-and-message image supplies the adjacent collective candidate for the passive subject.
The defining-by-time-or-limit image supplies the scheduling operation echoed by أُجِّلَتْ.

structural_cues: 77:11 is immediately followed by 77:12, and the broken-plural referent permits feminine-singular verbal agreement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messengers plus a passive timing verb; I carry that referent across the verse boundary and treat the near-parallel passive as specification. The alternative is that the focus asks about the entire preceding event complex.

changed_reading.before: The passive patient and the force of its delay are unresolved.
changed_reading.after: The messengers are docketed for a particular day, with the question demanding the day assigned to their appearance or testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named day gathers dispersed parties and then separates truth from falsehood by judgment; appointment becomes a convened adjudicative operation rather than a bare date.

activation_trace.role: The consequential event-day image anchors the focus as an operative occasion.
The fixed-limit image makes the occasion formally appointed.
The judgment-separating-truth-from-falsehood image identifies the appointed day's operation.
The day-or-summons that gathers people supplies the convocation preceding separation.

structural_cues: 77:13 directly answers 77:12, while 77:38 repeats the answer and immediately adds collective gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit answer, a judicial separation branch, and a gathering day; I order them as convene then adjudicate. They could instead be parallel attributes without a procedural sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks only when the deferred matter occurs.
changed_reading.after: It asks for the appointed assize at which parties are assembled so judgment can distinguish and separate.

context_deltas.mechanism: First and later cohorts are linked by following in sequence, so the appointed day can organize a queue of generations rather than merely postpone one undifferentiated event.

activation_trace.role: The open-span image allows ordered cohorts to be processed across a temporal horizon.
The fixed-term image gives the ordered sequence a common terminal appointment.
The beginning-and-priority image marks the first cohort in the sequence.
The succession image supplies the mechanism that moves from one cohort to the next.
The later-after-the-first image closes the ordered cohort relation.

structural_cues: 77:16-18 forms a first, then-following, later sequence capped by a statement of repeated action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicitly ordered cohorts; I treat that order as an administrative model for temporal appointment. The live alternative is that these are historical exempla rather than mechanics of the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: One unnamed matter waits for one endpoint.
changed_reading.after: Appointment coordinates successive cohorts toward a common terminal day, like a queue whose order is already fixed.

context_deltas.mechanism: A vulnerable origin is stabilized in a capable receptacle until a known measure; this makes the focus interval productive containment that reaches a calibrated threshold.

activation_trace.role: The fixed-term image anchors maturation to a predetermined endpoint.
The stability-and-settlement image supplies protected persistence during the interval.
The place-of-being image supplies the capable locus in which the latent process is held.
The measure-reaching-its-limit image turns waiting into calibrated development.
The disclosed-and-known image marks the threshold as determined rather than accidental.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 moves from a weak fluid origin through a secure resting place to a known measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies containment, capacity, measure, and knowledge; I map their developmental sequence onto the focus term. The alternative is that the creation sequence proves power independently and does not characterize the deferral.

changed_reading.before: The interval before the day is empty waiting.
changed_reading.after: The appointed interval resembles protected maturation: what is latent is held and measured until its known limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A containing earth gathers what it holds, then an imperative of unbinding and dispatch follows; the focus deferral can therefore be modeled as custody ending in compulsory release.

activation_trace.role: The open-span image anchors the duration of custody.
The collecting-basin image supplies the focus-root model of retained contents.
The enclosing-and-grasping vessel image expands retention from a word-level possibility into a whole-earth container.
The release-from-restraint image supplies the terminal transition out of containment.

structural_cues: 77:25-26 depicts the earth containing living and dead, followed in 77:29-30 by a repeated command to depart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a container and later release language; I join them as the two states of the focus deferral. The materially live alternative is that burial and commanded movement are separate scenes with no retention-release arrow.

changed_reading.before: The referent is postponed in abstract time.
changed_reading.after: It is kept in custody through the interval and compulsorily dispatched when the appointed day opens the container.

context_deltas.mechanism: An initial communication affords excuse or warning, but at the appointed day permission to excuse is denied; the term becomes a response deadline after which procedural speech closes.

activation_trace.role: The fixed-limit image anchors the expiration of a response period.
The excuse image supplies one possible purpose of the initial communication.
The fear-awakening warning image supplies advance notice before the deadline.
The permission image marks the procedural capacity that is withheld on the day.
The repeated excuse image closes the opening possibility by showing excuse-making no longer available.

structural_cues: The excuse root appears at 77:6 and again under negated permission at 77:36, bracketing the focus appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance excuse-or-warning and later refusal of permission; I treat the intervening appointment as a response window. The alternative is a rhetorical contrast that does not imply a juridical grace period.

changed_reading.before: The day is only when the event happens.
changed_reading.after: The day is also a filing deadline: advance notice has run its course and the opportunity to answer or excuse has expired.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present enjoyment is both extended for use and explicitly slight; the focus postponement becomes a short lease whose fixed expiration is already embedded in the permission to enjoy.

activation_trace.role: The fixed-term image supplies the lease's expiry.
The extended keeping for enjoyment image frames current use as temporarily allowed.
The littleness image sharply limits the apparent extension.

structural_cues: 77:46 combines imperatives of consumption and enjoyment with an immediate limiter of littleness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permitted enjoyment plus explicit smallness; I cast that permission as a lease bounded by the focus term. The alternative is that littleness qualifies benefit rather than duration.

changed_reading.before: Postponement might look like absence of consequence.
changed_reading.after: The delay is a brief, revocable lease of present use whose expiration is the appointed day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's nominal water-basin branch inside a passive scheduling verb. It remains anchored in أُجِّلَتْ and gains material support from water, stable containment, earth-as-vessel, and later release; downstream prose should present it only as a hydraulic analogy for deferral, not as the verb's lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أُجِّلَتْ carries the root whose B007 image is a basin that collects water before use.

activation_trace.role: The collecting-basin image turns temporal postponement into stored potential awaiting discharge.
The settling-and-stability image supplies persistence inside the reservoir-like interval.
The enclosing vessel image scales stored containment to the earth.
The literal water image keeps the basin analogy materially visible within the surah.
The unbinding-and-release image supplies the scheduled discharge from retention.

changed_reading.before: The matter is moved to a later date.
changed_reading.after: The interval acts like a temporal reservoir: contents settle and accumulate until the appointed day releases them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the affirmative-answer branch of ء ج ل is form-distant from أُجِّلَتْ and cannot replace its fixed-term sense. It remains root-anchored and resonates with promised occurrence and later belief; downstream prose should mark it as an echo in which reality supplies confirmation, never as a morphological translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of أُجِّلَتْ includes an affirmative-answer branch alongside its dominant term-setting branch.

activation_trace.role: The affirmative yes image supplies a secondary confirmation resonance inside the appointed-term form.
The falling-and-becoming-fixed image lets occurrence enact the confirmation.
The heart-settling belief image makes confirmation the surah's closing epistemic issue.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks only about when a promised event is scheduled.
changed_reading.after: At the appointed day, occurrence itself becomes reality's delayed yes to a promise that had not been believed.

strongest_changes: The adjacent messenger and timing language resolves the focus passive toward messengers formally docketed for a day.
The explicit answer and later gathering turn a date into an assembly whose work is adjudicative separation.
The excuse-warning bookend turns the fixed term into the closure of a response window.
Containment, known measure, and release keep a more exploratory reading alive in which deferral preserves latent contents until their threshold.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made several mechanisms coexist: promised arrival, messenger scheduling, judicial assembly, generational sequencing, gestational measurement, material containment, procedural expiry, and a brief lease of enjoyment.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive subject may be the messengers specifically or the broader preceding event complex.
The reservoir and custody readings may be productive material analogies rather than active senses of the focus verb.
يَوْمٍ may foreground a bounded date, an open duration, or the severity of the occasion without forcing one choice.
